tourDashboardStatsBody: These tiles count your menus, orders, and everything still in progress. Tap one to jump straight there.
tourDashboardCreateBody: Create a menu once, then reuse it for every order round you run with the same people.
tourBucketsTemplateBody: A menu is a template. Editing it never touches orders you already placed.
tourBucketsRoundBody: Open a new round from a shared menu and everyone on it is invited automatically.
tourOrdersListBody: Search and filter past orders here, and open any one to repeat it.
tourSocialBody: Add friends and groups so a shared menu can reach them in one tap.
tourSettingsBody: Preferences, privacy, security, and your data each live on their own page.
tourBucketEditorItemsBody: List every dish once. You can edit or deactivate an item later without touching past orders.
tourBucketEditorPricingBody: VAT, service, and delivery are stored with the menu and applied to every order made from it.
tourCollaborateQuantitiesBody: Each member sets their quantities. The totals update as contributions arrive.
tourCollaboratePlaceBody: Freezing stops further changes, then one order captures everyone’s picks and split charges.
tourBucketShareCodeBody: Send this code and anyone can join the menu without an invitation email.
tourBucketShareRolesTitle: Roles control what people can do
tourBucketShareRolesBody: Viewers only look, contributors add their own quantities, editors can change the menu itself.
tourSocialShareBody: Send the menu straight to a friend or a whole group instead of copying a code.
tourOrderDetailsRepeatBody: Repeat copies this order as a fresh draft; a new round re-opens the menu for the same people.
tourOrderDetailsStatusBody: Place, complete, or cancel the order as it progresses. Completed and cancelled orders are final.
tourCreateOrderQuantitiesBody: Use plus and minus for each dish. Anything left at zero is simply not ordered.
tourCreateOrderTotalsBody: The summary shows the subtotal plus every charge before you place the order.
tourSessionsBody: Every order round you organise or take part in is collected here until it is settled.
tourSessionDetailsMenuBody: These items were copied from the template when the round opened, so later menu edits cannot change it.
tourSessionDetailsParticipantsBody: See at a glance who has ordered, who is still deciding, and who opted out.
tourCreateSessionDeadlineBody: An optional cut-off time tells everyone when their choices need to be in.
tourCreateSessionAutoLockBody: Auto-lock stops accepting changes at the deadline so you do not have to watch the clock.
tourSettingsPreferencesBody: Name, language, theme, and currency are saved to your account and follow you to any device.
tourSettingsSecurityBody: You need your current password, so a forgotten session cannot change it for you.
tourSettingsAccountExportBody: Export downloads everything you own as a single readable file.
tourSettingsAccountDangerBody: You will be asked for your email and password first, and nothing is removed until they match.
tourJoinBody: Paste the code someone shared and the menu appears under "Shared with me".
tourSettingsPrivacyBody: Choose a level and the app records only that. Everything stays on this device and you can erase it here.
